track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 1: Kereshmeh
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Kereshmeh in Bayat-e Esfahan, Chahargah, Mahur, Nava. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb2 and dwells most on A in Kereshmeh. The line peaks at A4 (443.5 Hz) at 3:59.9. It closes on the tonic (E4 → E4 → E4 → E4 → E4 → E3).
